_comment: HAND-WRITTEN. Every value here is a decision no generated artifact carries.
Not under provider-codegen/generated/, which is machine output nobody edits.
A key is a Terraform type name as the provider registers it. An entry is
required for every surface served by internal/resourcekit and forbidden for
every surface that is not -- both directions, because data cannot fail to
compile the way a missing closure would. It can only fail to be there, and a
one-directional check lets a surface drop out of generation while everything
sdk_type is the go-unifi struct. It derives the method names too:
Create<T>, Get<T>, Update<T>Fields, Delete<T>, List<T>. What it cannot
derive is WHETHER a masked update exists -- BGPConfig, Site and
WireGuardPeer have only a whole-object Update, and a surface on those is
duration_units keys a wire field to its unit. 74 conversions in the tree use
seconds and 3 use minutes, all three on wlan, so a default would be silently
